description: Full page implementations: all 10 route pages fully implemented with real logic, charts, and interactivity. Also creates the complete Vitest test suite (8 new test files). Depends on FEAT-002 (utilities) and FEAT-003 (components and routing stubs). Pages must use the components from FEAT-003 and utilities from FEAT-002.
steps: Implement src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: hero section with WattWise headline 'Know Your Electricity Plan' and subheading about Consumption Digital Twin. Feature cards for each novelty (Digital Twin, Break-Even Explorer, Risk Shield, Regret Guard, Peak Shift Advisor) using FingerprintCard/etc preview visuals. Demo profiles section showing DEMO_PROFILES from samplePlans.ts with quick-start buttons that pre-fill the calculator. CTAs: 'Start Comparing' → /calculator, 'View Plans' → /plans. Demo disclaimer banner. Responsive layout using existing .hero, .features-grid CSS classes.

Implement src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: renders AuthPanel component centered on the page. Reads redirect param from URL search params (useSearchParams) and redirects there after successful login. If already logged in (useAuth), redirect to /profile. Show Firebase-not-configured message if isConfigured is false.

Implement src/pages/CalculatorPage.tsx: form with ConsumptionInput fields — Consumer type (household/small-business radio), Billing period (monthly/bimonthly radio), Optional provider name (text), Optional tariff schedule code (text), Off-peak kWh (number), Shoulder/normal kWh (number), Peak kWh (number). Auto-calculate and display total kWh, off-peak%, shoulder%, peak% as read-only derived fields. Validation: all kWh fields non-negative finite numbers, at least one plan must exist. Plan selection: show SAMPLE_PLANS plus any user custom plans from state. 'Add custom plan' button opens PlanEditor inline. On submit: store ConsumptionInput in sessionStorage as 'ww-consumption', navigate to /comparison.

Implement src/pages/ComparisonPage.tsx: reads 'ww-consumption' from sessionStorage (redirect to /calculator if missing). Calls recommendationEngine.generateComparison(consumption, plans). Shows: recommended plan highlight with savings amount (SavingsCard), bill breakdown table for each plan (BillBreakdownTable), a grouped Recharts BarChart of all plan totals, links to /digital-twin, /risk-shield, /shift-advisor. 'Save this comparison' button (calls saveComparison if authenticated, else prompts login). Stores full ComparisonResult in sessionStorage as 'ww-result'.

Implement src/pages/DigitalTwinPage.tsx: reads 'ww-result' from sessionStorage (redirect to /comparison if missing). Shows FingerprintCard with the computed UsageFingerprint. Shows consumption breakdown (off-peak/shoulder/peak percentages as a Recharts PieChart with accessible summary table). Shows BreakEvenCard with the BreakEvenResult. Explains what the fingerprint means for the user's tariff choice.

Implement src/pages/RiskShieldPage.tsx: reads 'ww-result' from sessionStorage. Shows RiskSummaryCard. Shows a Recharts heatmap-style grid or grouped BarChart of scenario costs per plan. Shows cheapestToday, mostStablePlan, lowestWorstCasePlan. Includes the confidence score with disclaimer text 'This confidence score is based on simulated scenarios and is not a statistical guarantee.'

Implement src/pages/ShiftAdvisorPage.tsx: reads 'ww-result' from sessionStorage. Shows ShiftCard with the three shift scenarios. Shows a Recharts BarChart comparing original bills vs shifted bills per plan per shift percent. Shows the explainer text 'Moving X kWh from peak to off-peak hours could reduce the [recommended plan] estimate by ₹Y without reducing total consumption.' Disclaimer: 'Not every appliance can safely be rescheduled — consult your electricity provider.'

Implement src/pages/PlansPage.tsx: shows all available plans (SAMPLE_PLANS + user custom plans from localStorage or Firestore if logged in). Renders each as PlanCard. 'Add Custom Plan' button opens a PlanEditor form. On save: if logged in call saveCustomPlan, else store in sessionStorage. Plans stored here are used by ComparisonPage. Allows deleting custom plans.

Implement src/pages/SavedPage.tsx (protected): calls getComparisons(uid) on mount. Shows list of saved ComparisonResults as cards with timestamp, recommended plan name, and savings. Click to view full comparison (navigate to /comparison with result in sessionStorage). Delete button calls deleteComparison. Shows 'No saved comparisons yet' when empty.

Implement src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx (protected): shows user displayName, email, photoURL (from Firebase User object). Shows count of saved comparisons (fetches from Firestore). Shows 'Sign Out' button that calls signOut() from AuthContext and redirects to /. Shows custom plans count.

Implement src/pages/RegretGuardPage.tsx — NOTE: The spec includes RegretCard which is shown within RiskShieldPage rather than a separate route. Embed the RegretCard inside RiskShieldPage.tsx below the RiskSummaryCard. No separate /regret route is needed.

Create tests/billingEngine.test.ts: tests for flat tariff (all rates 6.25 → same charge per kWh), TOU tariff (peak rate 9.00 vs offpeak 4.25), monthly vs bimonthly fixed charge (bimonthly should be 2x), tax calculation (5% duty), surcharge added to subtotal, decimal values, zero usage (only fixed charge), both plans equal (tie scenario), cheapest plan selection. Import from src/utils/billingEngine.ts and src/data/samplePlans.ts.

Create tests/digitalTwin.test.ts: test all four fingerprint labels. peak%=48.6% (Peak-Heavy) → 'Peak-Heavy Household'. offPeak%=46% → 'Off-Peak Optimiser'. shoulder%=51% → 'Daytime Dominant' (household) or 'Daytime Small Business' (small-business). balanced usage → 'Balanced Household'. Import from src/utils/digitalTwin.ts.

Create tests/breakEven.test.ts: crossover found between flat and TOU plans with balanced profile; no crossover when rates are identical; total stays constant in all tested points; result crossoverPeakPercent is not hardcoded (computed from plan rates — verify by changing a rate and confirming the crossover moves). Import from src/utils/breakEvenEngine.ts.

Create tests/riskShield.test.ts: generates exactly 25 scenarios (5×5); no negative consumption in any scenario; confidence score is between 0 and 100; planStats aggregated correctly (avgCost is mean of 25 bills); cheapestToday matches the plan that wins at multiplier=1.0 and delta=0. Import from src/utils/riskShield.ts.

Create tests/regretGuard.test.ts: regret=0 when selected plan is always cheapest across all scenarios; maxRegret>0 when usage shifts make another plan cheaper; explanation text is generated (non-empty string). Import from src/utils/regretGuard.ts.

Create tests/shiftAdvisor.test.ts: total kWh preserved in all 3 shift scenarios; unitsShifted = peak * (shiftPercent/100); savings are positive when shifting to cheaper off-peak rate; recommendation change detected when shifting causes plan switch. Import from src/utils/shiftAdvisor.ts.

Create tests/auth.test.ts: mock Firebase auth (vi.mock firebase/auth with signInWithPopup, onAuthStateChanged, signOut). Test: login success sets user; popup-closed-by-user error shows friendly message; loading state is true while auth resolves; signOut clears user; onAuthStateChanged restores auth state on reload. Use @testing-library/react to render AuthProvider and use useAuth hook.

Create tests/firestore.test.ts: mock firebase/firestore (vi.mock). Test: saveComparison writes to users/{uid}/comparisons path; getComparisons returns array of ComparisonResult; deleteComparison calls deleteDoc; each function throws when db is null. Import from src/lib/firestore.ts.
acceptance_criteria: npm run test — all tests pass including all 8 new test files
npm run build — succeeds with no TypeScript errors
ComparisonPage correctly shows Smart TOU as recommended for Balanced Household profile (offPeak:120, shoulder:150, peak:80)
ComparisonPage correctly shows Flat Saver as recommended for Peak-Heavy profile (offPeak:70, shoulder:110, peak:170)
DigitalTwinPage shows fingerprint label and usage percentage breakdown
RiskShieldPage shows 25 scenarios with confidence score
ShiftAdvisorPage shows 3 shift scenarios with savings
SavedPage redirects to /login when not authenticated
ProfilePage shows user info when authenticated
verification: npm run test — all tests pass including new billingEngine, digitalTwin, breakEven, riskShield, regretGuard, shiftAdvisor, auth, firestore tests
findings: All 167 tests pass (101 pre-existing + 66 new across 8 test files). Build succeeds. All 10 route pages fully implemented. Used explicit .ts extensions on samplePlans.ts imports to resolve ambiguity with legacy samplePlans.js. auth.test.ts renamed to auth.test.tsx for JSX support. GoogleAuthProvider mock uses class syntax for constructability.
